data.body: RECURRENCE (single isolated, self-cleared) — ops-error sweep 2026-08-30. The documented intermittent recurred once in-window: **Reconcile Bridge** run 33304097826 failed at "Run reconciler" @ 2026-08-30T09:27Z, and the downstream **Reconciler Heartbeat Canary** went stale/red @ 10:06Z (run 33305679650). Both self-cleared — every subsequent hourly Reconcile Bridge run (16:26Z→23:24Z) and Heartbeat Canary run (12:10Z→00:23Z) is green. Exactly the "isolated single-hour failure, self-clearing" pattern this ticket characterizes. Since this bug is closed and the pattern is still recurring, flagging for reopen/root-cause consideration; not re-filed as a new ticket (single self-clearing blip).
